decisions.reason: As an award-winning premium stollen that is highly visible on the website and closely tied to the firm's confectionery core, management would likely justify and continue its commitment.

Although no explicit performance signal is shown, the bread remained prominently presented across two years, and its close fit with the firm's established bread business supports continued commitment.
The marzipan Christmas stollen is central to the firm's traditional seasonal offer and has been kept on its own page, making management likely to persist unless clear failure becomes unavoidable.
